motivation: The first prospective validation reused the original 128 visitor histories with new demographic seeds. This second validation tests transfer to entirely new synthetic visitor histories generated by the same frozen visitor-history process.

prior_evidence.prior_ordering: large_plant_capacity > natural > visitor_pooled for reproducibility of history-specific continuous effects

primary_validation.statistic: four-repeat mean reliability of history-structured continuous effects from the same balanced variance decomposition used in discovery
primary_validation.inference: 1999 paired visitor-history bootstrap resamples, RNG seed 1042026
strong_success_rule: observed reliability ordering large_plant_capacity > natural > visitor_pooled
95% paired-bootstrap interval for large_plant_capacity minus natural reliability entirely > 0
95% paired-bootstrap interval for visitor_pooled minus natural reliability entirely < 0
terminal occupancy >= 0.95 in every validation arm
primary_validation.weak_success_rule: ordering holds but one or both paired-bootstrap intervals include zero; report partial transfer only
primary_validation.failure_rule: ordering fails; demote environmental-history transfer claim

secondary_validation: all three unique balanced 2-versus-2 split-half history correlations from the four demographic repeats
mixed-sign history counts at epsilon 0 and 0.01
stopping: run exactly visitor-history seeds 75001-75128 and demographic seeds 301-304; no history extension, seed replacement, threshold tuning or outcome-based stopping
claim_boundary: This is independent synthetic visitor-history validation under the same frozen history-generating process, not natural-island validation.
The environmental-history generator itself is unchanged, so this tests out-of-history-sample transfer within Model 3 rather than transfer to a new ecological process.
Capacity scaling and visitor pooling remain biological interventions, not pure statistical manipulations.
No natural variance component, branch prevalence, evolutionary rate or field effect size is inferred.
